ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels, while 25% consists of low-intensity black pixels concentrated in a central hourglass-shaped region and the distal right tip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity black region originating at the peduncle and extending toward the median notch. Multiple discrete, low-intensity linear streaks and punctate clusters are distributed across the white fields of both lobes, with a dense mapping of dark pixels on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; notch depth represents roughly 15% of the visible fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe presents frequent low-amplitude serrations (peaks < 15 pixels). Right lobe exhibits a high-amplitude, irregular jagged excision featuring three distinct macro-valleys and two sharp peaks, indicating significant structural loss.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe lobe displays a continuous convex curve. Right lobe sweep is discontinuous due to a major jagged excision on the trailing edge, resulting in a stepped geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, raised circular pixel clusters localized on the distal margin of the left lobe tip. Several isolated dark circular punctations are mapped on the inner right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple sub-parallel and unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) concentrated on the inner right lobe and the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large-scale traumatic indentation/missing tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe, resulting in a highly irregular and jagged profile distinct from standard serration.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent epibiotic barnacle clusters creating a high-relief, textured boundary on the leftmost distal tip.
